card.title: Nintendo Wii The Picture is Noisy, Bad, Glitching, or Missing

source.title: Nintendo Wii The Picture is Noisy, Bad, Glitching, or Missing

claims.statement: Wii bad video: check the brick outputs 12 V DC, then check SMD electrolytic caps—compare composite video before and after the video filter cap; cheap Wii-to-HDMI adapters also cause it.

procedure: Check SMD electrolytic caps, especially the video filter cap.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
